description: Four-burner heavy-gauge steel gas grill with a side burner, warming rack and room for twelve burgers.
Compact folding propane grill for camping and tailgating, with a single burner and push-button ignition.
Budget two-burner gas grill with a lid thermometer, grease tray and electronic ignition.
22-inch porcelain-enamelled charcoal kettle with adjustable vents and an ash catcher.
Wi-Fi pellet smoker with app temperature control, a 10 lb hopper and a meat probe.
Smokeless electric grill for indoor use, with removable non-stick plates and adjustable heat.
Heavy-duty waterproof grill cover with vents and an elastic hem, sized for full-size grills.
16-inch stainless steel locking tongs with heat-resistant grips.
Three stainless steel spatulas: a wide burger turner, a slotted fish spatula and a thin-edge flipper.
Two-prong carving fork with an extra-long handle for turning roasts and steaks.
Silicone-coated gloves rated for handling hot grates and meat.
Wireless dual-probe meat thermometer with an app, preset meat temperatures and alarms.
20 lb bag of hardwood hickory pellets for pellet smokers.
20 lb bag of natural hardwood lump charcoal.
Bag of hickory wood chips for adding smoke flavour on any grill or smoker.
Pack of odourless natural fire lighters for charcoal.
Six regional barbecue rubs, from Memphis sweet to Carolina tang.
